import struct
def px(r,g,b): return struct.pack("BBB", r,g,b)
def png(w,h,data):
    # simple IDAT PNG
    import zlib
    def chunk(tag, payload):
        return struct.pack(">I", len(payload)) + tag + payload + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag+payload)&0xFFFFFFFF)
    header = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w,h,8,2,0,0,0)
    data = b"".join([b"\x00"]+list(data))
    idat = chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(data))
    iend = chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    with open("tex.png","wb") as f: f.write(header+chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr)+idat+iend)
data = b"".join([b"".join([px(0,0,255) if x<16 else px(0,255,0) if x<32 else px(255,0,0) for x in range(48)]) for y in range(16)])
png(48,16,data)
EOF

func _ready():

    var data := FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes("res://tex.png")
